name: issue-templates
description: The issue templates for a bug report and a feature request, written for a visitor from outside, and the config that turns off blank issues

name: socket
description: The Socket config, which limits the Socket GitHub app's pull-request scans to changes in dependency and workflow files

name: workflow-bun-pr
description: The pull-request workflow that runs the shared Bun checks

name: workflow-audit-fix
description: The workflow that turns a red bun audit into a fix pull request, or a pull request that records an ignore with a reason and an expiry

name: skill-testing
description: The shared testing skill and its references; a repo keeps its own rules in a project-testing skill

name: skill-code-style
description: The shared code-style skill, whose role table the verb-contract lint rule's test pins; a repo keeps its own rules in a project-code-style skill

name: skill-docs-writing
description: The shared docs-writing skill and its prose, length and link check scripts; a repo keeps its own rules in a project-docs-writing skill

name: skill-skill-writing
description: The shared skill-writing skill and its check-skill script, which docs-writing's check-length runs when it is present

name: skill-ci-design
description: The shared ci-design skill, which holds the patterns for a GitHub Actions pipeline; a repo keeps its own pipeline in a project-ci-design skill

name: skill-pr-evidence
description: The shared pr-evidence skill, which has an agent upload a PR screenshot to the files.geoff.cloud file drop and link it, never commit it; every repo takes it, because every agent that opens a pull request needs it

name: hook-skill-gate
description: The skill-gate hook's entry point, which runs the gate from the @zgeoff/skill-gate package for Claude Code and Codex; the repo installs the package, keeps its path and tool gates in .claude/skill-gate.json, registers the hook in .claude/settings.json with a PreToolUse matcher that names each gated tool, and for Codex registers it in .codex/hooks.json with --harness codex and trusts the hook definitions

name: memory-cap
description: The script that runs a command inside a cgroup memory cap with no swap, and prints the run's peak memory and OOM kills; every repo takes it, because the pre-push baseline runs its jobs under it

name: pre-push-baseline
description: The light pre-push baseline: lefthook jobs that check only what the branch changes and run one at a time under a memory cap, a pre-commit typecheck, the scripts they call, the package scripts files:branch, lint:files, test:related, check:commits, check:local-paths, check:test-timeouts and memory-capped where the repo lacks them, and a move of a files:branch script left on the old script path
build: old='bun scripts/collect-branch-files.ts'; new='bun scripts/read-branch-files.ts'; if [ "$(jq -r '.scripts["files:branch"] // empty' package.json)" = "$old" ]; then jq --arg new "$new" '.scripts["files:branch"] = $new' package.json > package.json.tmp; mv package.json.tmp package.json; fi; add=$(jq -cn --arg new "$new" --arg capped 'bash scripts/run-memory-capped.sh "$(bun scripts/read-memory-budget.ts)"' '{"files:branch":$new,"lint:files":"oxlint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern","test:related":"bun scripts/run-related-tests.ts","check:commits":"bun scripts/run-commits-check.ts","check:local-paths":"bun scripts/run-local-paths-check.ts","check:test-timeouts":"bun scripts/run-test-timeouts-check.ts","memory-capped":$capped}'); missing=$(jq -c --argjson add "$add" '(.scripts // {}) as $s | $add | with_entries(select(.key as $k | $s | has($k) | not))' package.json); if [ "$missing" != '{}' ]; then jq --argjson missing "$missing" '.scripts = (.scripts // {}) + $missing' package.json > package.json.tmp; mv package.json.tmp package.json; fi
